title: Apple: modeled ₹1,813/qtl left, Naraingarh → Una
summary: January 2024: reported apple prices at Naraingarh and Una imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 76% of 21 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,813 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 250 same-variety market pairs screened for apple in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Una report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Una (Himachal Pradesh) both reported apple prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 21 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹6,100 per quintal. Una reported a median ₹9,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,900/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,900 per quintal, and Una was dearer on 86% of days.

scenes.headline: 188 km by road
scenes.caption: 188 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹40/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹2,079 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹1,568 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Una report, the rule selects 19 of 21 modeled shipping days. 16 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,813 per quintal (₹1,352 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Apple route from Naraingarh to Una was positive on 76% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹181,300, or ₹135,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to apple
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹40/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Apple route from Naraingarh to Una was positive on 76% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹181,300, or ₹135,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Apple: modeled ₹2,207/qtl left, Kathua → Hamirpur (Nadaun)
summary: December 2024: reported apple prices at Kathua and Hamirpur (Nadaun) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 20 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹2,207 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 188 same-variety market pairs screened for apple in December 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Delicious, Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Hamirpur (Nadaun) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: December 2024
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported apple prices for the same variety and grade (Delicious, Medium) on 20 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹9,000 per quintal. Hamirpur (Nadaun) reported a median ₹12,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹3,250/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹3,250 per quintal, and Hamirpur (Nadaun) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 182 km by road
scenes.caption: 182 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹39/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,877 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹1,263 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 19 of 20 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹2,207 per quintal (₹1,591 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Apple route from Kathua to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 95% of matched days in December 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹220,700, or ₹159,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
